gbm_population_evidence.quote: IDH-wildtype glioblastoma (9440/3), giant cell glioblastoma (9441/3), gliosarcoma (9442/3), epithelioid glioblastoma (9440/3), IDH-mutated glioblastoma (9445/3)
diffuse astrocytoma (9400/3), diffuse midline glioma H3 K27M mutated

candidate_evidence.quote: In vitro and in vivo experimental studies have suggested that anthracyclines are effective antineoplastics for the treatment of gliomas.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Not previously treated (with chemo and radiotherapy) or treated only surgically (total, near partial, partial, biopsy).

role_evidence.quote: Dox 4 cycles with 37.5mg/m2/day by continuous infusion over 48 hours (2 days) every 28 days (maximum cumulative dose 300mg/m2)
this study aims to evaluate the safety and antitumor activity of combined treatment with Dox, WBRT (whole body radiotherapy), and TMZ
Currently, the standard of treatment is TMZ concomitant with radiotherapy, and, at the end of combined treatment, as adjuvant therapy.

coder_notes: Eligible ages 3 to 30 years (stdAges includes CHILD and ADULT: mixed_age). Eligibility lists several diagnoses (IDH-wildtype and IDH-mutated glioblastoma, gliosarcoma, diffuse astrocytoma, H3 K27M diffuse midline glioma), so mixed_glioma_gbm_named; no single molecular marker is an entry requirement, so no biomarker rows. Radiotherapy is listed as a 'Drug' intervention in the registry but is not coded as an agent. Single arm; experimental regimen is Stupp backbone plus doxorubicin.
